headline: Catawba pull clear at the top of the chart
dek: Catawba beat Virginia State at home on Wednesday and have now scored twenty-two goals and conceded three in five wins and a draw, more than any other programme has scored. Lincoln Memorial put Lenoir-Rhyne away the same night and, like Catawba, have yet to drop a point in conference play.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Catawba have scored twenty-two and conceded three, and no one player has more than Alex Payton's four of those goals.

wire.line: Catawba have conceded three goals all season, and only Belmont Abbey have taken a point off them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and every Emory & Henry match but Tuesday's, the latest of them at home to Palm Beach Atlantic.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lincoln Memorial have scored eleven and conceded five in three wins, a draw and a defeat; the defeat was their opener at Palm Beach Atlantic.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lenoir-Rhyne are still without a win: two draws and four defeats, eight scored and sixteen conceded, the latest defeat at Lincoln Memorial on Wednesday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lincoln Memorial's Daniel Benedek Miklosi has made twenty-six saves and conceded five goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry's win at Bob Jones was their first of the season; they have scored seven and conceded sixteen in one win and five defeats.

last_match.line: Catawba remain unbeaten, and have not conceded since their win over North Greenville in August.

next_match.line: Catawba have not conceded since August; Emory & Henry's only published result is a draw with Anderson.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
